visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a dimly lit, greenish-tinted underground parking garage, a young man with dark hair, wearing a white oversized t-shirt, stands cautiously. He holds a smartphone with a glowing screen, his face showing a mix of suspicion and nervousness as he glances around at the shadows. The background consists of dark concrete pillars, parked cars, and low-level artificial lighting that creates deep shadows. (2) The scene transitions to a medium-full shot where the same man begins an energetic and rhythmic dance routine in the empty parking lot. He performs fluid arm movements and footwork, contrasting his previous fearful demeanor. The lighting remains low and atmospheric, emphasizing the movement of his white shirt against the dark, industrial background. (3) The setting shifts to a brightly lit indoor office or studio environment. A man in a light blue suit jacket and black t-shirt is seated at a cluttered desk with computer monitors. He has a concerned expression. Close-up shots show a green desk fan falling over, a kitchen faucet dripping into a sink, and colorful stickers on a wall moving independently. (4) The camera focuses on the man in the blue jacket as he looks around in confusion and fear. A variety of household and office objects are shown behaving erratically, suggesting a paranormal presence. The final frame features a sudden close-up of a realistic tiger head appearing in the office space, looking directly at the camera with its mouth open.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, eerie synthesized strings create a suspenseful, horror-movie atmosphere. A low-frequency hum provides a sense of dread. There are no vocals, only the spectral shimmering of the dissonant music. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a sudden shift. An energetic electronic dance track with a heavy, driving kick drum and synthesized bass begins immediately. The BPM is fast, and male vocal chops are heard in the background of the mix. (3) The dance music cuts out abruptly, replaced by a brief silence then casual dialogue. A young male voice speaks with a clear, inquisitive tone, followed by another male voice responding calmly. Ambient room tone is low. (4) A loud, percussive thud SFX occurs as an object falls, followed by a wet, echoing drip sound. Several high-pitched cartoon-style stingers and sliding sound effects highlight the visual movement of objects. (5) A deep, resonant, and distorted tiger roar sound effect dominates the final two seconds, featuring heavy low-end frequencies and a wide spectral bandwidth, ending the track with high arousal.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage -> Linear: The video begins with a stylized montage showing contrasting behavior (fear vs. confidence) in a parking lot, then shifts to a linear comedic narrative set in an office.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic skit produced by a popular Taiwanese creator group, themed around 'Ghost Month'. It parodies the dual nature of people who are superstitious and fearful but also want to express their personality or continue their daily routine, using paranormal tropes for humor.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high production value in both visual editing and sound design to create a parody of horror films, specifically catering to the 'Ghost Month' cultural context in Taiwan.
